author: Midnightstorm
title: What's your favorite ice cream flavor?

replies.author: StewieFG
replies.body:
Chocolate with oreo.

The ice cream I usually order (I call it the sweet bomb xD):
-2 Ice cream balls in a big crunchy waffle :3
-First ball: Chocolate with oreo peaces 
-Second ball: First half vanilla with oreo, second half normal chocolate.
-Additives: Oreo, Chocolate Chip, chocolate cookies, chocolate hot cream.

This is the real ice-cream.
